control_name: Financially-relevant batch jobs are monitored and failures resolved
control_objective: Financially-relevant batch jobs are monitored, their failures raise alerts, and every failure is resolved, so that financial data is processed completely and accurately on schedule.
risk_addressed: Unmonitored or unresolved failures of financially-relevant batch jobs can leave financial transactions unprocessed, duplicated, or incomplete, misstating the financial statements and breaking downstream automated controls.

required_data_elements.business_definition: An execution of a financially-relevant batch job, including completion status.
The incident ticket and resolution record for a failed job run.

method.summary: Inspect financially-relevant job runs to confirm failures raised alerts and were resolved through to closure.
steps: Pull all financially-relevant job runs in the period from the scheduler logs.
Identify failed runs and confirm an alert was raised for each failure.
Match each failure to a resolution ticket and confirm closure.
Count unresolved failures and compute the failure-alerting rate.
method.fallback_logic: If either source is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any unresolved failure of a financially-relevant job is a control exception; missing alerting is a warning.

pass_criteria: No unresolved failures of financially-relevant jobs.
warning_criteria: Not all job failures raised an alert.
fail_criteria: One or more financially-relevant job failures remain unresolved.
Job run population cannot be evidenced.
exception_handling: Open a SOX deficiency issue if any financially-relevant failure is unresolved.

assertions.description: No unresolved failures of financially-relevant jobs.
All job failures raise an alert.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each quarter before §302 certification.

actions_on_fail: Notify IT Operations Manager and Controller
